list.unknown_collection: The service does not report a collection with this slug. It may have been renamed or removed.
list.filters_description: Narrow the list down. The search runs on the service, across titles and text.
list.tag_filter_hint: One tag, spelled the way it was saved.
list.entries_description: Everything the collection holds — drafts and archived entries included.
list.caption: Entries in {{name}}
list.reorder_description: Drag the entries into the order they should appear in, then save. Nothing is written until you do.
list.reorder_unavailable: Reordering needs the whole first page, unfiltered — clear the filters to turn it back on.
list.no_matches_description: Try a shorter search, another status, or drop the tag.
list.empty_description: Create the first {{name}} and it lands here. Drafts count, so you can start one now and publish it whenever it is ready.
list.delete_body: “{{title}}” will be removed for good, and there is no undo. If it might come back, set its status to Archived instead — that hides it from the website without losing the text.

editor.new_description: A new entry in {{name}}. It stays a draft until you publish it.
editor.loading_description: Fetching what is stored for this entry.
editor.save_failed: The entry could not be saved
editor.unsaved_body: Nothing is written until you save.
editor.leave_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave this entry and lose them?
editor.basics_description: What this entry is called, and where it sits in the collection.
editor.title: Title
editor.title_placeholder: The name this entry goes by
editor.slug_hint: The URL this entry answers on. Changing it breaks the links that already point here.
editor.slug_derived: Left as it is, it follows the title: {{slug}}
editor.slug_empty: Derived from the title as soon as you type one.
editor.subtitle: Subtitle
editor.subtitle_hint: One line under the title — a role, a client, a place.
editor.summary_hint: The short version, used in listings and previews. {{used}} of {{max}} characters.
editor.position_hint: Manual order inside the collection: the lower number comes first. Leave it empty and the collection decides.
editor.featured_hint: Featured entries are the ones the site pulls forward.
editor.body_description: The long text, in markdown. Optional — plenty of entries are a title and a summary and nothing else.
editor.links_description: Where this entry points, and when it happened.
editor.url_hint: Where the entry sends a visitor: a repository, a live site, a certificate.
editor.image_url_hint: Full URL of the image shown alongside this entry.
editor.started_at_hint: When it began. Leave it empty when it has no date.
editor.ended_at_hint: Leave it empty while it is still going.
editor.ended_before_started: The end cannot fall before the start.
editor.tags_description: How this entry is grouped and filtered.
editor.tags_hint: Enter or a comma adds the tag. Up to 60 characters each.
editor.data_description: The payload that belongs to {{name}} alone, stored as JSON. Each collection validates its own shape, so a field it does not know about is rejected rather than saved.
editor.delete_body: “{{title}}” will be removed for good, and there is no undo. If it might come back, set its status to Archived instead — that hides it from the website without losing the text.
